scenicChapters.title: San Francisco del Valle de Tilaco → Santa María del Agua de Landa
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 18 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-san-francisco-del-valle-de-tilaco.story: From Agua Zarca it runs 215 km to Agua Zarca; allow about 3 h 42 of riding. It goes by way of Santa María del Agua de Landa, Franciscan Missions in the Sierra Gorda of, Nuestra Señora de la Luz de Tancoyol and Santiago de Jalpan. The highest point is about 1,600 m.

scenicChapters.title: Kenya Great Rift Valley Escarpment Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
